name: AI Chatbot Alert Policies
description: NRQL alert conditions for the Next.js AI Chatbot application. Import these into New Relic or use as reference for manual setup.
instructions: 1. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID with your actual New Relic account ID
2. Replace YOUR_POLICY_ID with your alert policy ID
4. Import via New Relic API or create manually in the UI

alertConditions.name: High Error Rate
alertConditions.description: Triggers when error rate exceeds 5% for 5 minutes

nrql.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-assistant'

alertConditions.name: Slow API Response Time
alertConditions.description: Triggers when average response time exceeds 2 seconds for 5 minutes

nrql.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-assistant' AND transactionType = 'Web'

alertConditions.name: AI Completion Failures
alertConditions.description: Triggers when AI completion failures exceed 10 in 5 minutes

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM AICompletion WHERE success = false

alertConditions.name: High AI Response Latency
alertConditions.description: Triggers when average AI completion time exceeds 10 seconds

alertConditions.name: Cache Hit Rate Degradation
alertConditions.description: Triggers when cache hit rate drops below 70% for 10 minutes

alertConditions.name: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
alertConditions.description: Triggers when connection pool utilization exceeds 80% for 5 minutes

nrql.query: SELECT latest(poolActive) / latest(poolMax) * 100 FROM SystemHealthCheck WHERE poolMax > 0

alertConditions.name: Health Check Failures
alertConditions.description: Triggers when health endpoint returns non-healthy status

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM SystemHealthCheck WHERE status != 'healthy'

alertConditions.name: Rate Limiting Triggered
alertConditions.description: Alert when significant number of requests are being rate limited

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE error.class = 'ChatSDKError' AND httpResponseCode = 429

alertConditions.name: Slow Time to First Token
alertConditions.description: Triggers when streaming TTFT exceeds 2 seconds average

alertConditions.name: Database Query Errors
alertConditions.description: Triggers when database errors exceed threshold

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE message LIKE 'Database%failed%' OR message LIKE 'Database%error%'

alertConditions.name: High Token Usage
alertConditions.description: Alert when token usage is unusually high (cost monitoring)

alertConditions.name: Apdex Score Drop
alertConditions.description: Triggers when Apdex score drops below 0.85

nrql.query: SELECT apdex(duration, 0.5) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-assistant'

alertConditions.name: Low User Activity
alertConditions.description: Alert when no user activity is detected for 15 minutes (possible outage)

alertConditions.name: Slow Database Queries
alertConditions.description: Alert when slow database queries exceed threshold

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE message LIKE 'Slow database%'

alertConditions.name: High Request Metrics DB Calls
alertConditions.description: Alert when average DB calls per request is unusually high (N+1 query problem)

alertConditions.name: Guest Session Creation Spike
alertConditions.description: Alert when guest session creation rate is unusually high (possible abuse)

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM UserAction WHERE action = 'guest_session_created'

recommended.description: Primary alerting channel for team notifications
